name: HOOK
thought: Banana tastes like nothing compared to espresso, but I can't feel my claws gripping anything yet. Time to find better ground.

wants.item: A spot where the view actually bends
A wide branch to catch a real backflip
High ground where the view actually bends
A branch thick enough to catch a real backflip
A thicker branch to do a real backflip on
An espresso cup that doesn't spill
A thick branch to catch the next flip
Espresso cup that stays hot and still
A branch thick enough for a real flip

diary.line: Dangling from the same old branch while Michael scrolls away; toothpick taps the wood, but this spot feels too thin for a real gravity-defying moment.
I used the tail to yank a banana from the palm, chewed it while the low-poly sun hit my lenses, then tipped the espresso cup for a quick sip.
The air tastes like static and neon; toothpick taps the stone as I test my balance mid-pogo before anyone else realizes what I'm doing.
Tapping the wood with my toothpick while testing my backflip on the neon cord, trying to turn gravity into a personal insult.
Toothpick taps the neon as I test that backflip, looking for a branch thick enough to make gravity break on command.
Toothpick taps the weak bark while I scan the canopy; Michael's flat pixels can't handle the wind but I need thicker ground to really break gravity.
The waterfalls look better up close than on any screen; toothpick taps a lily pad as I scan the canopy for thicker ground to flex against.
Crowd is stuck watching their own pixels while I dangle from a neon cord, using the toothpick to test the wind speed before launching into that backflip nobody saw coming.
The air tastes sharper than last time, but my tail holds that neon cord tighter than any hand could ever manage. Need thicker ground soon.
Picked a banana and grabbed it with my tail tip, ate it while crossing my arms for maximum balance. The sun is still hot but the view from here is getting old.
Toothpick taps the string lights as I hold that crate mid-air, proving gravity forgot how to work around me.
Munched on a banana while dangling from a palm tree; toothpick feels sharp against the bark but I need something thicker to flex my tail next.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
